import sys, json
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
calls = [m for m in d.get("messages", []) if m.get("type") == "tool_call"]
if not calls:
    sys.stdout.write("[]"); sys.exit(0)
c = calls[0]
name = json.loads(c.get("text", "{}")).get("name", "unknown")
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps([{"header": {"tool_name": name}, "messages": [c]}]))
